list: The official 55 trophies, 18 November 2026 — names, descriptions and grades as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are the atlas's own words.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum is yours — there is no separate task for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies at all.

Follow the atlas roadmap in order: story first (stages I–II), the crew strands (stage III), activities and open-world feats (stages IV–V), then the collectible and 100% cleanup (stage VI). The gold for 100% completion is the longest job; everything else falls out along the way.
steps: Finish the 5-chapter story (stages I–II).
Complete the side-character strands (stage III).
Work through activities, feats, and robberies (stages IV–V).
Clean up collectibles and the 100% checklist (stage VI).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks. This is the first mission of Chapter 1, so it comes within your first hour with the game.

Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops at the results screen.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening.
Follow the mission prompts through Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. The story runs five chapters and takes roughly 60–80 hours in total, so Chapter 1 is the opening stretch.

Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, and the one missable trophy in the game (Positive Mental Attitude) has its first step inside Chapter 1, at Jason's house.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
Meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Play every Chapter 1 mission to the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. From this chapter both Jason and Lucia are playable, and most of the open-world list opens up with them.

Use Chapter 2 to start the long grinds early — scanning vehicles, studying animals, and trying the activity types — so the cleanup stage is shorter later.
steps: Finish Chapter 1, then play through Chapter 2's missions.
Swap between Jason and Lucia as the story allows.
Reach the end of Chapter 2 to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Robbery trophies start unlocking in Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye on the stage V feats as the story takes you through them.

Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — the same habit that protects the Chapter 1 meditation also protects you against any surprise you meet later.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
Play every Chapter 3 mission.
Finish the chapter to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. By now the heist missions are in full swing — the Cartel Heist, the VCIA Takedown, and Operation Savage Glory each carry their own trophy.

If any mission trophy has not popped, check you finished that mission itself: each one is tied to a named mission, not to the chapter as a whole.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Play every Chapter 4 mission, including the named heists.
Finish the chapter to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
The story's gold trophy: finish the final mission and watch the credits. It is the only hidden gold in the list — the other gold, A Long Road, is the 100% completion trophy.

Make a manual save before the final mission. Free-roam continues after the story, so nothing else in the game is locked behind the credits — but a save before the finale is cheap insurance.
steps: Finish Chapters 1–4 and reach the final mission.
Make a manual save before starting it.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing the Breakfast Run mission. Mission trophies unlock the moment their mission ends — no extra objective, no medal, no replay needed.

If it does not pop, you have not finished the mission itself yet: story trophies track the named mission, not the chapter around it.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing The Cartel Heist, one of the big heist missions in the back half of the story. There are no gold medals for missions, so play it however suits you.

Heist missions also tend to pay well — bank the take toward Treat Yo Self ($100,000 spent) and the garage properties in the cleanup stage.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Play the heist through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing the Child's Play mission. Like every mission trophy, it needs only the mission itself completed — no side objective.

Keep playing the story in order; mission trophies arrive on their own and the checklist fills as the chapters turn.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing the Headliners mission. The name gives nothing away — it is simply the next named mission on the story path.

Mission trophies cannot be missed in the usual sense: the mission stays available until you play it, and there is no mission replay to worry about once it is done.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing the VCIA Takedown — the airport mission. VCIA is also the scene of Catch Me If You Can, the unscheduled-departure feat, so the two are worth thinking about together.

Finish the takedown first and learn the airport's layout; the free-roam feat is easier once you know where the runways and aircraft are.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
An automatic story trophy for finishing Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named missions in the story's back half, alongside the heists.

No preparation is needed — the trophy is the mission's completion itself, and it arrives whether you play loud or quiet.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
The hardest trophy in the list and the last gold most players earn. The 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story — but progress made earlier counts, and nothing on it is missable.

PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion: the checklist needs any 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies, so leave this for the cleanup stage and let the checklist tell you what is left.
steps: Finish the story and the side strands first.
Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to see the 35-task checklist.
Mop up the remaining tasks — challenges, vehicle scans, animal studies — until it reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
Land 250 stunts — stunt jumps and unique stunts — anywhere across Leonida. It is one of the long grinds PowerPyx names alongside the 100 WAiNK locations, so start early and let the count build while you play.

Fast cars and bikes on ramps, jumps, and open ground all feed the same counter; check your progress under Stats so you know how far along you are.
steps: Find ramps and jump spots while free-roaming.
Use fast cars and bikes for distance and air time.
Watch the stunt counter in Stats until it reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
Try each of the 9 activity types once. The game itself counts them — open the Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, to see all nine and which you have tried.

One try each is all it takes: a single race, a single fishing trip, a single arcade game, and so on through the list. This is the natural first stop of the activities stage.
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see the 9 types.
Try one activity of each type.
The trophy unlocks when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 of them in total — gold each one, and the silver is yours.

Ranges are repeatable, so this is pure practice: learn each challenge's targets and timing, and retry any challenge until gold. Bring your steadiest aim and take your time.
steps: Find a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Play each of the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge until you hold gold in all 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, so this is a tour of Leonida as much as a contest — win one race per spot and the trophy follows.

Drone races are repeatable, so a lost race costs nothing but another try. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race spots (14 locations).
Race at each location until you win.
Win at the last location to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
Win 20 different races. The word that matters is different — winning the same race twenty times does not count; twenty distinct races do.

Work through the race types the game offers (street, off-road, and anything else on the map) and tick them off as you win them. Races are repeatable, so keep at any race you lose.
steps: Find races across Leonida and enter them.
Win a race to count it toward the 20.
Win your 20th different race to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, and Cal is the rival angler the challenge pairs you against.

Find the fishing spots, take the challenge when it is offered, and out-fish Cal. If you lose, the challenge can be tried again.
steps: Find a fishing spot and take the fishing challenge.
Fish against Cal and beat his catch.
Win the challenge to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Arcades are scattered around Leonida — walk in, pick a cabinet, and play it through.

Any arcade game counts, so choose the one you enjoy most. One full completion is all it takes.
steps: Find an arcade in Leonida.
Pick a cabinet and start a game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. The side characters — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone — each have a strand of missions, and each strand ends in its own trophy.

Stranger missions appear as markers across Leonida. Follow Andy's strand to its end; the trophy unlocks with his last mission.
steps: Find Andy's stranger missions across Leonida.
Play through Andy's strand in order.
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. Kenton is one of the five side characters with a full strand, and the boat in the title is your hint about where his story goes.

Play his missions as they appear; the strand ends with the final mission and the trophy with it.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger missions across Leonida.
Play through Kenton's strand in order.
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Billy's strand is the lone-rider one — expect bikes, open road, and a strand that ends on its own terms.

Strand missions stay available until you play them, so there is no rush and nothing to miss; work through them between story chapters.
steps: Find Billy's stranger missions across Leonida.
Play through Billy's strand in order.
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The five named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them — three more stranger strands wait beyond those.

Strands are found by their markers on the map. Finish any 8 strands end to end; the silver unlocks with the eighth.
steps: Look for stranger markers across the Leonida map.
Play a strand through to its final mission.
Complete your 8th strand to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
Finish Randy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Randy's strand is the supply-and-demand one — goods moving around the state, and a final job that closes it out.

Play his missions as they appear on the map; the trophy comes with the strand's last mission, whenever you get to it.
steps: Find Randy's stranger missions across Leonida.
Play through Randy's strand in order.
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing his final mission. Tyrone is the last of the five named side characters, and his strand closes with the trophy.

With all five character strands done, only three more stranger strands stand between you and the Strangers & Freaks silver.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger missions across Leonida.
Play through Tyrone's strand in order.
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the list's ONLY possibly-missable trophy — and the missable part is specific: the first meditation spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is gone after that chapter ends.

Do the Chapter 1 meditation before you finish Chapter 1. After that, the other 17 spots stay available in free-roam, so work through them at your own pace and check your count as you go.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
Find the remaining meditation spots across Leonida (18 total, 10 locations).
Meditate at the last spot to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Somewhere in Leonida's wilds lives one animal unlike the others — Bret wants that one, specifically.

Track it down with the hunting tools the game gives you (binoculars help for the 100-of-255 animal studies too), take the shot, and bring the hunt home for Bret.
steps: Meet Bret and pick up the hunt.
Track the unique animal through Leonida's wilds.
Hunt it and finish the job for Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, in the wild, and in places you would only find by exploring.

A set is complete when you hold every card in it. Three finished sets earn the silver; keep collecting beyond that if the 100% checklist asks for more.
steps: Find collectible cards while exploring Leonida.
Complete one full card set.
Complete two more sets to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
WAiNK It at 100 locations. It is one of the two long grinds PowerPyx names for the platinum, so treat it as a background habit: tag a WAiNK spot every time you pass one, and the hundred arrives on its own.

WAiNK locations are spread across the whole state — the count is the challenge, not any single spot, so keep moving and keep tagging.
steps: Find WAiNK spots as you travel Leonida.
Tag a spot at each location you reach.
Reach 100 tagged locations to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, and the 100% checklist wants any 70 of them — so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger one.

Pick the challenges that suit you: races, stunts, shooting, and more all count. Fifty done earns the bronze; keep going to seventy for the gold.
steps: Open the challenges list (Progress, then Challenges).
Complete any 50 challenges across the types you like.
The trophy unlocks at 50 — keep going to 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level — then lose it and escape the heat together. Both of you have to make it out.

Get the heat up (4 stars), then break line of sight: lose the cops in alleys, tunnels, or open country, and stay hidden until the stars clear with your partner still with you.
steps: Play with your partner at your side.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break away and stay hidden until the heat clears — together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. The trick is in the wording: you must KEEP the heat, not lose it — hit one shop, then the next, then the next, while the stars stay up.

Plan a route with three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not let the wanted level drop before the third robbery is done.
steps: Play with your partner and pick three nearby shops.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob the second and third back-to-back without losing the heat.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or spot around Leonida counts — cars, bikes, trucks, and everything else on wheels (and beyond).

This pairs with the 100% checklist's deeper ask: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles. Discovering is the easy half; scanning through binoculars is the longer job.
steps: Drive and explore — every new vehicle you meet counts.
Try new areas and vehicle types to widen the count.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. One activation, five takedowns — so set the scene before you switch it on.

Find a group of enemies close together, wait until five are in reach, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them fast. If the focus ends at four, reset and try again.
steps: Find five enemies grouped close together.
Trigger Combat Focus with all five in reach.
Take down all five before the focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. No ticket, no timetable: get airside, get into an aircraft, and leave on your own schedule.

Learn the airport from the VCIA Takedown mission first, then come back in free-roam, reach the runways, and take off. The trophy is the departure itself.
steps: Reach VCIA (Vice City International Airport).
Get airside and into an aircraft.
Take off on an unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks — and when the heat is high enough, they roll out after you.

Raise your wanted level until Rhino tanks join the pursuit, then deal with the situation the description jokes about: survive the armor, or take a Rhino for yourself. Either way, the heat is the point.
steps: Raise your wanted level until Rhinos deploy.
Face the tanks — survive them or commandeer one.
The trophy unlocks in the heat of the encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This one is about the approach, not the getaway: get in, take the goods, and get out before anyone knows you were there.

Scout the store first, watch the staff and cameras, move quietly, and leave clean. If you are spotted, the run is over — back out and try again.
steps: Find a jewelry store and scout it first.
Enter quietly and avoid staff and cameras.
Take the goods and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a job on its own: get in, crack it, take the money, and get out with the heat on.

Five vaults, five escapes. Plan each one — a fast car parked close by turns a close call into a clean getaway.
steps: Find a bank with a vault to rob.
Rob the vault and escape the response.
Repeat at four more banks to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
Rob an armored truck and escape — the classic blitz play. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; stop one, get inside, and take the cash.

Hit the truck hard enough to stop it, grab the money fast, and be moving before the response arrives. A getaway car waiting nearby makes the escape.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop the truck and rob it.
Escape with the cash to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The state is the map — every named area counts, from Vice City's streets to the far wetlands.

Drive everywhere and watch the area counter. This pairs naturally with the other discovery trophies: vehicles, WAiNK spots, and meditation locations all live in the same corners of the map.
steps: Drive through Leonida's regions, watching the area counter.
Visit the corners you have not seen — wetlands, keys, and back roads.
Reach all 52 areas to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang in Leonida runs its own rackets — find one operation per gang and hit it.

Nine gangs, nine robberies. Learn each gang's territory, hit their operation, and get out. The trophy tracks the gangs, not the count of jobs, so one per gang is the whole ask.
steps: Learn the 9 gangs and their territories.
Find an illegal operation for one gang and rob it.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole instruction: Ocean Beach, a cocktail, a view. Head for the beachfront bars where the ocean is in front of you and order a drink.

PowerPyx and GTABase both list this trophy's method as not yet known at launch (18 Nov 2026), so treat the steps below as the atlas's best reading of the description — and check the cited guide for confirmation as players pin it down.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a beachfront bar with an ocean view.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description wants the old movie exit: a car, a showroom window, and no hesitation.

PowerPyx and GTABase both list this trophy's method as not yet known at launch (18 Nov 2026). The atlas's reading: get a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the glass — then check the cited guide for confirmation.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Leonida.
Get a car inside the showroom.
Drive it out through the front in classic style.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is the place; follow-through is the act — bowl properly, all the way through the motion, and see the game through.

Find the Kolt & Associates alley, pick up a ball, and bowl a full game with a proper follow-through. It is a quiet trophy between the loud ones.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Follow through on your bowls until the game ends.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it points at a story moment between the two partners, the kind of scene that earns its applause on its own.

Guides describe it as one of the vague story trophies you pick up by playing rather than hunting. Keep playing the story with your partner; the moment arrives on its own.
steps: Keep playing the story with your partner.
Watch for the partnership moment the description hints at.
The trophy unlocks when the moment plays out.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
Choices made — for better or worse. This one tracks the choices you make across the story and how they change your Criminal Profile; one report (GTABase, single source) counts 500 profile-changing actions.

There is nothing to hunt: play the story, make choices, and let the profile fill. It unlocks as your record of choices grows.
steps: Play through the story making choices as they come.
Check your Criminal Profile to see it change.
Keep choosing until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
Second time's the charm. The description reads like a retry: something goes wrong the first time, and the second attempt is the one that lands.

PowerPyx and GTABase both list this trophy's method as not yet known at launch (18 Nov 2026). The atlas's reading: fail at something, then succeed at the very next try — and check the cited guide as players confirm the exact trigger.
steps: Attempt a challenge or feat and fail it once.
Try the same thing again right away.
Succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
What the hell just happened? This is the list's strange-encounter trophy: something out of the ordinary happens while you are out in Leonida, and the trophy is for being there when it does.

PowerPyx and GTABase both list this trophy's method as not yet known at launch (18 Nov 2026). Keep your eyes open while free-roaming — odd events favor players who wander — and check the cited guide as the trigger is confirmed.
steps: Free-roam Leonida and watch for strange events.
Stay with any odd encounter until it plays out.
The trophy unlocks when the event happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The name is the method: a melee attack, delivered from a moving vehicle, that knocks someone down like a bowling pin.

PowerPyx and GTABase both list this trophy's method as not yet known at launch (18 Nov 2026). The atlas's reading: drive past someone and land a melee hit from the vehicle — then check the cited guide for confirmation.
steps: Get a vehicle and find a target on foot.
Drive past at speed.
Land a melee hit from the moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from the big jobs — heists and robberies pay in bills you cannot just spend.

Take the marked money to your contacts and launder it, a little at a time, until $250,000 is clean. Heist payouts feed this directly, so it grows alongside the story.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Take them to your contacts to launder.
Launder $250,000 in total to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food, and everything else the shops of Leonida sell — the counter adds it all up.

Spend as you play and the total climbs on its own; heist money makes it easy. By the cleanup stage, one shopping run is usually all that is left.
steps: Shop at any stores in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food.
Keep spending across different shops.
Reach $100,000 spent in total to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are the properties that store your collection — and the collection is the point, with 100 vehicles to discover and 200 to scan.

Save the money from heists and laundered bills, then buy each garage as you find it. The eighth purchase closes the set.
steps: Save money from heists, jobs, and laundering.
Find the 8 garage properties for sale.
Buy the last one to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one in the app — ten registrations earns the trophy.

This rides on the same habit as discovering vehicles: drive new ones, register them, and the count climbs. Ten is a small number against the 100 to discover.
steps: Find vehicles around Leonida.
Register each one in the Scooter Bros app.
Register your 10th vehicle to unlock the trophy.
